_comment: Pinned external tooling. acl-offsetgen refuses to execute a binary whose
SHA-256 is not listed here, so swapping the dumper on disk fails closed
instead of silently producing offsets from an unknown build.
To move to a newer Il2CppDumper: bump tag/asset/size, run
tools/fetch-il2cppdumper.ps1 -Update to print the observed digests, review
them against the upstream release page, then paste them in and commit.
Never let a script rewrite this file unattended -- the whole point is that a
human signs off on the change in a reviewable diff.

why_this_asset: Il2CppDumper-win-*.zip is the self-contained win-x64 build. The framework
dependent net6/net7 assets need a .NET 6 runtime, which is end of life and
no longer installed on current machines -- that was bug F11 in the audit.

archive.pinned_note: GitHub does not publish a digest for this asset (it predates the release-asset digest feature), so this is trust-on-first-use: downloaded once, digest recorded, verified on every fetch and every run afterwards.

binaries.note: used for both x86 and x64 game files; the -x86 suffix on the other binary refers to the dumper's own architecture, not the target
32-bit build of the dumper, kept for hosts without x64
